content: nawu Yawey! Karriwayinin nuye mankongkerrnge kore karrimirndemornnamerren, ngad bininj nuye nawu karridjalwoybukwon nawu Yawey.
Ngad bininj rowk nawu Israel kankebmawahmeng, wanjh karriwernhmarrmarrnin bu karriburrbun nungka kanmarnbom. Mak karrinjilngmakmen nuye nawu king kadberre, ngad nawu karrihni kunred Zion.
Karringeyburlumen nuye kunngey kore karrimarneborrkke! Karrimarnebun nawu cymbals dja harps bu karriburlume nuye.
Yawey kanmarnedjare ngad nuye bininj dja wanjh kadjalnjilngmak kadberre. Dja bininj nawu minj bedman kabirriburlumerren, wanjh Yawey kabenngehke dja kabenngeykimukwon.
Wanjh bininj nuye birridjalburlumen God bu kunmekbe kunmak kabenmarnekurduyime. Bedda wanjh birridjalwayinin nuye kunnjilngmak dorrengh bu kukakkuyeng.
Wanjh birrikayhmen bu birriburlumen nawu God. Mak birrikarrmen kunbid bedberre nawu mandjawak manmirrkmak duninjh.
Bedda wanjh kabindibun bininj nawu birrikang kubolkbubuyika bu kabenbun nawu birriwarre bininj rowk.
Warridj birrimekbe nawu God nuye bininj wanjh kabindidukkadukkan wirlmurrng chains dorrengh kings nawu kabirriwohrnan kore birriwarre bininj, dja kabindibongkurrme wirlmurrng chains dorrengh.

Kuhni kabirriyime kore God benmarnebimbom nawu birriwarre bininj, bu nuye bininj wanjh kabindibun. Kuhni wanjh kabirriwinhme duninjh nawu God nuye bininj rowk. Mah, wanjh karriburluburlumen nawu Yawey!

footnotes.text: Karriburlumen kayime “Hallelu Yah” kore Hebrew kunwok.
